name: noe
description: A complete 74-agent AI workforce organized like a real IT company, aligned with Claude Opus 5.5 (orchestration & hard reasoning) and Claude Sonnet 5.5 (default workhorse — 1M context, 21 opus / 53 sonnet agents), with Claude Haiku 5.5 per invocation for read-only sweeps, digests, and bulk extraction. Runs in Claude Code (CLI, Desktop, IDE) and Claude Cowork. 12 divisions including executive leadership, strategic planning, engineering, QA, SecOps, AI/ML, mobile, construction AI, content & localization, and business development. Features persistent memory, 34 skills with preloading (including humanizer and council-of-experts), official plugin integrations, /loop recurring tasks, delegation discipline and unattended-run steering for Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, and Agent Teams support.
